name: @pipeworx/mcp-stripe_connect

_apiKey.description: Stripe secret or restricted API key (sk_...)

tools.name: stripe_get_customer
tools.description: Get a Stripe customer by ID.

_apiKey.description: Stripe secret or restricted API key (sk_...)

tools.name: stripe_list_charges
tools.description: List Stripe payment charges for your account, optionally filtered by customer ID. Returns charge ID, amount, currency, status, and timestamp. Supports limit (1-100) pagination.

_apiKey.description: Stripe secret or restricted API key (sk_...)

tools.name: stripe_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions on a Stripe account via the Stripe API (api.stripe.com/v1/subscriptions), authenticated with a Stripe secret or restricted key passed as _apiKey, with optional customer id and status filters (active, canceled, past_due, trialing, unpaid) and a limit of 1-100. Returns each subscription id, customer, price and plan items, status, and current period start and end. Answers who is subscribed to a Stripe billing plan and on what terms.

_apiKey.description: Stripe secret or restricted API key (sk_...)

status.description: Filter by status (active, canceled, past_due, etc.)

tools.name: stripe_get_balance
tools.description: Get the current Stripe account balance.

_apiKey.description: Stripe secret or restricted API key (sk_...)

tools.name: stripe_list_invoices
tools.description: List Stripe invoices, optionally filtered by customer ID and/or status (draft, open, paid, void, uncollectible). Returns invoice ID, amount due, due date, and payment status.

_apiKey.description: Stripe secret or restricted API key (sk_...)

status.description: Filter by status (draft, open, paid, void, uncollectible)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-stripe_connect forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the stripe_connect pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
